label: Local service business (general)
audienceNote: Local customers deciding who to call. They want to understand what the business does, see that it covers their area, and take a clear next step.
tone: Clear, friendly and professional. Plain language. No hype.

pages.name: Home
sections: Header with the business name, a click-to-call phone button and a quote or booking button
Hero: what the business does, the service area if known, one primary and one secondary button
Services overview: one card for each service in section 3 and no others
How it works: a simple three-step path (no promised times or prices)
Questions customers ask (generic, no invented policies)
Final call to action with the phone number and enquiry

pages.name: Services
sections: One block per service listed in section 3 and no others, each with a short description and a call button

pages.name: Contact
sections: Phone, email and address only if provided in the facts; otherwise clearly marked placeholders
Enquiry form (preview only: the form must not submit anywhere)
Service area and hours only if provided

trustCueRule: Licensing, insurance, certifications, warranties, years in business, ratings and guarantees may be shown ONLY if they appear in the verified facts. Otherwise leave a clearly marked placeholder such as [TO CONFIRM: licence details].
imageGuidance: Use no stock photographs of other companies. Use simple inline SVG or CSS shapes and marked photo placeholders such as [PHOTO: team at work].
artDirection: Hero: a full-bleed gradient mesh built only from the palette colours (soft blurred shapes that drift slowly), large custom inline-SVG artwork related to the trade, and a very large headline with one or two of its own words in the accent colour.
Services as a bento grid with one large tile, big simple inline-SVG icons, soft inner shadows and hover lift; never plain white boxes.
How it works as a vertical or horizontal timeline with a line that draws as the section scrolls into view and oversized outlined step numerals.
Past work placeholders in rounded frames with a faint grain and a clearly marked placeholder caption on each.
Closing section: a full-bleed dark band with a large display line and a single button; the footer has a very large faded business-name wordmark.
